$comment: Hand maintained. Things the public docs embed from this repository that are deliberately NOT run against the service, each with a reason. An entry is keyed by the docs-facing path (the path in the EmbeddedCode url, as the docs use it today) and the snippet ids; an entry without "ids" covers every embed of that path (whole-file embeds). Seeded from docs-snippets/coverage.json (modes stub and compile-only of the quickstarts). npm run test:integration:live:docs-check reads it.

exceptions.reason: Browser-only sample (needs window and a bundler or a script tag), so it cannot run in Node. Stays in docs-snippets/quickstarts/ and is type-checked by docs-snippets/tsconfig.browser.json (npm run test:docs-snippets:types); it is not run against the service. Old mode: compile-only.
